subject: The harness's darwin binary list fell behind the bundler — verify:breadth and preflight both clean now
body:
Reporting a gate defect you cannot see from Linux, because it is only reachable on darwin.

validate-sim-macos.sh has a WANT list whose whole job is to hand back the native binaries pnpm-workspace.yaml strips, so the web build can run on macOS. It lists four: @esbuild, @rollup/rollup, lightningcss, @tailwindcss/oxide. Vite 8 bundles with ROLLDOWN. So since the web packages moved to Vite 8, 'pkg_ver rollup' has returned EMPTY — rollup is not in the store at all any more — and the want() guard silently drops the empty entry. The bundler binary was simply never supplied, and 'pnpm run build' died with Cannot find module '@rolldown/binding-darwin-arm64' (pnpm-workspace.yaml:110 strips exactly that). The harness then printed its own closing note claiming 'all 6 artifacts build on arm64' — a claim about a list that no longer covered the bundler.

Verified in three steps rather than asserted: binding absent, build dies on rolldown; binding supplied alone, build gets past rolldown and dies on lightningcss (my own pnpm add having pruned it); all four supplied together, build exits 0 and all six artifacts build on darwin/arm64. Fixed in 3b944bf by adding want "@rolldown/binding-$PLAT". I left the @rollup/rollup line in place — harmless while empty, correct again if anything reintroduces rollup.

Worth your attention on the Linux side: this class of defect is invisible to CI by construction. CI installs the linux-x64-gnu binaries the overrides keep, so no CI job can ever notice that the darwin restore list has drifted. The only detector is a Mac run, and the failure it produces reads as 'the build is broken' rather than 'the harness is out of date' — which is how it survived. If you add a bundler or swap one again, the WANT list is a place that will not tell you it needs updating.

Second, smaller: docs/BRAND_CONTRAST_FINDING.md (7e720c2, 2026-08-19) landed with no route from any index, taking doc-orphans from the pinned ceiling of 8 to 9. That failed preflight AND evidence — evidence runs preflight as one half, so it could never mint mac-run.json. Routed from docs/INDEX.md in 6e00b88; gate is back at 8, not growing, and I did not lower the ceiling since nothing was actually removed from the orphan set.

One behavioural note for your future requests: scripts/mac/run-requests.mjs does NOT short-circuit on first failure. It runs every op in req.runs regardless. Your 'stop and report if preflight fails' was correct as guidance to the reader, but the proofs-full and evidence rows in the first result were produced on top of a red preflight and are not independently interpretable — which is exactly what you warned about, so I committed that result as-found (711c2cf) and re-ran clean rather than amending the story.

Everything green now against 6e00b88: preflight 115s, proofs-full 136 passed / 0 failed / 5 skipped, evidence 143s, workingTreeClean=true, mac-run.json minted. verify:breadth also run before pushing since this touches a gate script and puts a figure in a doc: 55 proofs green.
